title: encrypt(): doc says 'complete MIME message' but it lacks RFC 5322 message headers
description: build_mime() (called by encrypt()) produces headers Content-Type, Content-Transfer-Encoding, Content-Disposition, and body — but no From, To, Subject, Date, or MIME-Version at the outer RFC 5322 message level. The function doc says 'Returns a complete application/pkcs7-mime MIME message'. The word 'complete' will mislead callers expecting a sendable RFC 5322 message. Fix the doc to clarify it returns a MIME body part (the encrypted payload), not a complete message.
